<reason>B wins on the density/threshold clash. A showed many culture claims can be rewritten role-specifically, but B showed the honest remainder - be present so the floor is alive for others - cannot be a task of that role without restating broad culture, leaving A's rule either toothless if that sentence passes or paralyzing if it fails. A never resolved that enforcement dilemma.</reason>
